moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio squash, written here): Recipe: ball falls in 300 ms power1.in (easeInQuad), stretching with speed up to scaleY 1.2 / scaleX 0.85; at contact scaleY 0.75 / scaleX 1.33 (volume kept, origin bottom) for 2–4 frames; rises 300–550 ms power1.out back to 1/1. Site demo: endless parabolic bounce 112 px high, 1100 ms per bounce, stretch scaleY 1 + 0.22·v² (v = speed 0–1, scaleX = 1/scaleY), contact pose 0.72 / 1.36 for the 110 ms around the floor; an undeformed ghost alongside. Params: fall (0.3 s) · stretch (1.2 / 0.85) · squash (0.75 / 1.33) · hold: số khung bẹp (2–4). The recipe: a 0.3 s fall power1.in stretching to 1.2 / 0.85, 2–4 frames at 0.75 / 1.33 on the floor, a 0.3–0.55 s rise power1.out.
